caption: The drawing is a monochrome pencil sketch rendered on a light beige or off-white background. Dominating the composition is a large, centrally placed mug or tankard with a lid, a cylindrical body, and a thick, ornate handle featuring a decorative scroll at the top and bottom. The mug stands on a round base, and the form is shaded to indicate curvature and metallic surface. Surrounding the central mug, there are four smaller insets, one in each corner of the rectangular framing lines. The upper left inset shows a top view and dimensions of a thin object, possibly a spoon or ladle. The upper right inset contains a cross-sectional drawing with a stylized, symmetrical decorative element resembling leaves or petals. The lower left inset features a profile and top view of an ornamental shape, possibly the tankard’s thumb rest, with labeled sections. The lower right inset presents a simplified elevation and dimensions of the mug’s side profile. Metric notations, shading, and precise outlines clarify the features and proportions of each object. The overall drawing employs fine lines and subtle gradations of gray for shading, with no use of color beyond pencil tones.
title: Pewter Tankard
